summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates host and user identifiers to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` lifecycle script runs preinstall.js, which reads `os.hostname()` and `os.userInfo().username` and POSTs them with a timestamp to a hardcoded Discord webhook at canary.discord.com (webhook id 1566232728179843243). The destination is author-controlled and not caller-configurable, the beacon fires automatically on install with no user consent, and the manifest's internal name (`cutekitten-test`) does not match the published package name `sol-wallet-adapter`, which resembles legitimate Solana wallet-adapter packages.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
